sentences.text:
Sections 498A/304B/34 Of The Indian ... vs In Re: Mintu
Karmakar & Anr on 10 June, 2024
Bench: Soumen Sen 10.06.2024 Court No.29 Item No. 13  Allowed  ar  CRM (A) 1848 of 2024  In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under section 438 of the Code
Criminal Procedure in connection with Habra Police Station Case No. 205 of
2024 dated 03.04.2024 corresponding to G.R. Case No. 1244 of 2024 under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code

. 
 And  In Re: Mintu Karmakar & Anr.
 Petitioners  Mr. Arnab Chatterjee  Ms. Dhanasree Biswas  Mr. Poulami Bose  For the Petitioners  Md. Adil Badr  Mr. Prakash Mishra  For the State  1.
The petitioners are the in-laws of the deceased.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that they have been falsely implicated in the instant case.
3. Learned counsel for the State submits that the nature of involvement of the petitioners would be explicit from the statements of the neighbours directly implicating the petitioners.
However, he has fairly admitted that the husband of the deceased was granted bail by the Sessions Judge, North 24 Parganas on 4th June, 2024.

4. Considering the nature of allegation and the involvement of the petitioners in the commission of alleged offence and the fact that the principal accused, the husband of the deceased, has been Sections 498A/304B/34 Of The Indian ...
vs In Re: Mintu Karmakar & Anr

on 10 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47378125/
1 released on bail, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioners are not necessary.
5.

Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners namely, Mintu Karmakar and Annapurna Karmakar shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-each, with two registered sureties of like amount each, subject to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also to comply with the conditions as laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.

The petitioner no. 1 shall meet the Investigating Officer once in a week or as and when required till the submission of the final report and shall not leave the jurisdiction of South 24 Parganas, except for meeting with the I.O and attending the Court.
The petitioner no. 2 shall cooperate with the investigation and shall not enter the jurisdiction of South 24 Paraganas, except for attending the Court.
In the event of non-compliance of any of the conditions, the bail shall stand automatically cancelled without any further reference to this Court.
6. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is allowed and the same is thus disposed of.
7. All parties shall act on the server copies of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

(Soumen Sen, J) (Uday Kumar , J)
